newsitem.title: USA: Wells-Gardner Q1 hurt by sales comparison.
newsitem.headline: Wells-Gardner Q1 hurt by sales comparison.

text.p: Wells-Gardner Electronics Corp, reporting lower first-quarter earnings on sales that approximated the year-ago period, said 1996 sales included about $3 million of delayed sales from 1995.
The company said its margin of 13.3 percent in the first quarter compared with 13.9 percent in the fourth quarter.

Chairman Anthony Spier said margins improved as the quarter progressed and reached 16.4 percent in March. He attributed the improving trend to previously announced programs of driving down the cost on several high volume products, obtaining cost concessions from some major vendors, selective price increases and exiting some low-margin business.
